entries.text: Identify that some devices are connected by wires and that other devices are not.
Identify what robots are and where they may be found in the real world.
Know how to develop precise sets of instructions to complete simple tasks, such as drawing a picture of a particular object or building a brick tower.
Know how to recreate algorithms as programs.
Follow the steps in algorithms for everyday tasks.
entries.note: Teks dibaca di halaman Cambridge Community (tabel contoh Stage 1) tetapi tanpa kode; pemasangan kode 1CT.01 hanya dari cuplikan hasil pencarian atas salinan framework. Konfirmasi di PDF resmi sebelum dipakai.

entries.text: Identify single errors in algorithms that represent everyday events or tasks.
